about: Test photos for rapier-jxl. Pictures under photos/ are in the repository. The larger sets are tar files on the photos-2026-11 release: download one, check its SHA-256, and extract it. Every row names its license, author and source.

assets.name: checks.tar
assets.about: The pictures the checks read every time: six held-out originals, eight transparent photographs, ten page captures and one text page.

assets.name: open-collection.tar
assets.about: The open collection: 171 originals in 16 categories, tuning and held-out splits.

assets.name: open-phones.tar
assets.about: 40 phone photographs of 12 MP and up.

assets.name: bench-phones.tar
assets.about: 24 phone photographs, Pixel 9, iPhone 16 and Galaxy S25.

assets.name: video.tar
assets.about: Clips of Big Buck Bunny and Tears of Steel, 1080p and 4K.

assets.name: screens-open.tar
assets.about: Openly licensed web page screenshots, phone and desktop, light and dark.
